attributes.name: Hook Mountain Hag
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, succeed at an Arcane or Divine 8 check or you may not play spells with the Attack trait.

When you are dealt damage by the Hag, you must first choose spells to discard as damage, if you have any.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
